Subject: Deployability / air-gap questions for Redwood (RFP section 4)

Hi Kar

Thanks for the intro call earlier — BlueRidge has started the technical review portion of our RFP and section 4 is focused on private deployment (VPC / on-prem / air-gapped). The procurement team attached a baseline questionnaire but we also have a technical checklist that our infra team needs filled out to validate air-gapped installs, key management, and evidence for runtime isolation.

Can you fill out the attached checklist and return any supporting artifacts (network diagrams, attestations, or operator runbooks)? We're trying to complete vendor validation by next week.

Key items we care about: offline install process, KMS/HSM integrations, data-at-rest encryption, ability to operate without internet egress, patch/update workflow for air-gapped clusters, and audit logging retention.

Thanks — attaching the vendor checklist now (procurement included).

—Ellie

Subject: Internal: review notes on BlueRidge questionnaire

Karthik / Neha —

Quick notes while I reviewed the draft answers:
- Encryption: call out envelope encryption + KMS routing (we support customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault, and on-prem HSM connectors). Add operational play for key rotation.
- Offline updates: describe signed artifact bundle plus checksum verification and a recommended update cadence (quarterly security + ad-hoc hotfixes).
- Audit logs: we retain operator and API audit logs for configurable windows; default 90 days for hosted, but for private deployments we support local retention up to customer policy. Mention retention export capability.
- PII handling: confirm we can configure local-only logs and offer sanitized support bundles.

I'll add a short paragraph to the attestation about our internal acceptance tests for air-gapped installs. Neha — can you confirm the HSM vendor list to include in the appendix?

—Monica

Subject: Re: Deployability / air-gap questions for Redwood (RFP section 4)

Ellie / BlueRidge team —

Attached is our completed deployability questionnaire (redwood-deployability-questionnaire.pdf), a redacted network topology (network-topology-example.svg), and a signed attestation (attestation-20270622.pdf). Highlights / clarifications inline below:  

- Offline install: Redwood provides an air-gapped installer (tarball with GPG signatures + SHA256 checksums). Operators transfer bundles via USB or secure scp to the isolated admin subnet. The installer includes an offline package repo and documented scripts for container image import.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) over private endpoints and on-prem HSMs via PKCS#11. Certain HSM connectors require operator driver installation; we document the steps and provide a pre-flight checklist.
- Telemetry & egress: Telemetry is disabled by default in Private deployments. When enabled (customer choice) telemetry is buffered and forwarded through a customer-configured proxy; the default install can run with zero egress.
- Updates & patches: We deliver signed patch bundles. Recommended cadence: quarterly security updates, with an emergency hotfix pathway. For air-gapped installs, operator pulls signed bundles onto the isolated network and runs the offline apply tool — process documented in operator-runbook (excerpt included in questionnaire appendix).
- Audit logging: API and operator audit logs are retained locally; retention configurable. We support exporting logs to customer-managed S3/NFS for long-term retention and ship a log-archival script in the bundle.

Next steps: please confirm if BlueRidge needs a notarized/attested signature (we can sign with our security lead + legal) or if an internal-signed PDF suffices for procurement. If you'd like, we can walk through the network topology and offline update flow in a 30-minute session — available Thursday morning.
